steps.text: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs mostly clear. Put it in a pot with 250 ml water and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to minimum and cook 15 minutes. Don't lift the lid.
While it cooks: cover the edamame with hot tap water. Slice the cucumber, grate the carrot, slice the avocado and green onions.
Cut the salmon into 2 cm cubes. Toss with 30 ml soy sauce, the sesame oil, honey and half the green onions. Keep it in the fridge.
Rice done: take it off the heat and leave it covered to rest.
Stir the rice vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved. Fold into the rice.
Mix the mayonnaise and sriracha. Drain the edamame.
Build the bowls: rice, then salmon and each vegetable in its own section. Drizzle spicy mayo and the last 15 ml of soy. Finish with sesame seeds and green onions.

chicken-couscous-boursin.name: One-Pan Chicken Thighs, Couscous and Boursin

steps.text: Pat the chicken dry and season with thyme, salt and pepper. Finely chop the shallot and garlic. Halve the tomatoes. Zest the lemon, then cut it in half.
Heat the oil in a large deep pan with a lid, medium-high. Lay the chicken in and sear without moving it.
Flip the chicken and cook the other side. It won't be cooked through yet.
Move the chicken to a plate. Turn the heat to medium, add the shallot and garlic and stir.
Add the couscous and stir to toast it.
Pour in the broth and scrape up the browned bits. Bring to a boil, then set the chicken back on top with its juices. Cover and simmer on low until the couscous is tender and the chicken reaches 74°C.
Lift the chicken out again. Stir in the Boursin, tomatoes and spinach until the spinach wilts and it turns creamy.
Squeeze in the lemon juice and add the zest. Slice the chicken and lay it on top.
Dice the tomatoes and red onion. Shred the lettuce, slice the avocado, chop the cilantro, grate the cheese and cut the lime into wedges.
Mix the chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, oregano and salt in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan, medium-high. Add the beef, break it up and cook until browned.
Drain off extra fat if there's a lot. Stir in the spice mix and 60 ml water. Simmer until saucy.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, about 30 seconds a side. Wrap them in a clean towel.
Build the tacos: beef, lettuce, tomato, onion, avocado, cheese, a spoon of yogurt, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.
Mix the beef with the Worcestershire, salt and pepper. Shape two patties a little wider than the buns and press a thumb dent into the middle of each.
Slice the tomato, red onion, pickles and cucumber. Slice the cheese.
Heat a pan with a little oil, medium-high. Cook the patties without moving them.
Flip, lay the cheese on top and cook until the centre reaches 71°C.
Move the patties to a plate to rest. Toast the buns cut-side down in the same pan.
Toss the greens and cucumber with the rest of the oil, the vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Build: bun, mustard, a few greens, patty, tomato, onion, pickles, ketchup. Salad on the side.
